_doc: Parent settings (story 11.4, services/parentLogic.js, ui/screens/ParentGateScreen.js and ParentSettingsScreen.js). The gate asks an arithmetic question a kid in class 3 does not do in their head (a product of a two-digit and a one-digit number plus a two-digit number) with four answers; a wrong answer shuts the gate for lockoutSeconds and brings a new question, and `strikes` wrong answers in a row lock it for longLockoutSeconds. Settings are saved in the family's flags: parentDifficulty (the learning difficulty modifier the learning engine reads, within data/learning.json parentRange), chasesOff (no bullies chase), playReminder (minutes of play after which a friendly break reminder appears, 0 = off; it repeats after the same time). Texts: parent.*.
